title: OptiMobile+
description: OptiMobile Better optimization on mobile devices, higher FPS even on an older phone.
body:
## What is this for?

OptiMobile+ was made for mobile Java players using Amethyst or Zalith Launcher. This enhanced version of the mod pack is focused on delivering higher FPS, smoother gameplay, and a more stable overall experience on mobile devices.

OptiMobile+ includes Sodium, a performance optimization mod designed to improve rendering efficiency and reduce lag. The pack also comes with carefully selected mobile-compatible shaders. However, not every device can handle every shader smoothly depending on hardware limitations.

The recommended shader for most devices is Makeup Lite because it provides a balanced visual upgrade while still maintaining good performance even on lower-end phones.

Unlike normal optimization packs, OptiMobile+ is tuned specifically to reduce stuttering, improve frame consistency, and make gameplay feel more responsive. Still, keep realistic expectations - optimization helps performance, but it cannot fully compensate for extremely weak hardware.

---

## Help, it's not loading?

Sodium developers and Amethyst developers have had conflicts in the past, so avoid requesting Sodium support in those Discord servers.

This mod pack was built using mods that were personally tested and confirmed working on mobile devices, including lower-spec phones. If the game is not loading, double-check your launcher setup and renderer configuration.

---

## Help, 1.16.5 isn't working?

Minecraft 1.16.5 requires either Zink or Krypton Wrapper Renderer for Sodium to function correctly. Zink is also recommended if you want shader compatibility.

---

## Will there be other versions?

Yes. More Minecraft versions are planned in the future, but currently OptiMobile+ focuses on the latest stable versions first.

---

## Does this pack have shaders?

Yes. The pack includes optimized shaders designed for mobile performance and stability. Shader support may vary depending on Minecraft version and device capability.

You can also install additional shaders yourself and experiment with what runs best on your phone.

---

## The mod pack crashes?

Make sure you are using the correct renderer. Sodium requires LTW or Mobile Glues to function properly. Incorrect launcher configuration is one of the most common causes of crashes.

When configured correctly, OptiMobile+ is designed to provide a significantly more stable gameplay experience compared to many standard mobile Java setups.

---

## Can I add other mods?

Yes. You are free to install additional mods alongside OptiMobile+.

The pack intentionally focuses on performance optimization and stability instead of unnecessary extras, allowing users to customize their experience further.

---

## Does this work on PC?

Yes, it works on PC as well. On desktop systems you can combine OptiMobile+ with mods like C2ME, Chunky, or Distant Horizons for even greater performance improvements.

Some of those mods are not fully compatible with mobile devices, which is why they are not included by default.
